spec2def(powrprof.dll powrprof.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# powrprof.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/powrprof-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(powrprof_shims OBJECT powrprof.c)
target_link_libraries(powrprof_shims PRIVATE wine libadvapi32 libuser32 libcomctl32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(powrprof_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_compile_definitions(powrprof_shims PRIVATE _CRT_NON_CONFORMING_SWPRINTFS)
add_cargo_module(powrprof powrprof-cargo powrprof.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS powrprof_shims psdk)
